# Run when the hall opens: the Inventions page always has a sub-page.
DA_DH_init = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { DA_DH_any_subpage = yes } }
		set_country_flag = DA_show_inventions_Arcane
	}
}

DA_DH_show_page_rf = {
	clr_country_flag = DA_Racial_Interface_on_Dwarven_research_facility
	clr_country_flag = DA_Racial_Interface_on_Dwarven_wonders
	clr_country_flag = DA_Racial_Interface_on_Dwarven_inventions
	set_country_flag = DA_Racial_Interface_on_Dwarven_research_facility
	DA_DH_init = yes
}
